reasoning: OAuth2 flow decomposes into the three deliverables explicit in the body's acceptance section.

children.title: Sign-in button + redirect to Google consent
children.body:
Add a 'Sign in with Google' button on the login page; clicking redirects to the Google OAuth consent screen.

**Acceptance:**
- Button visible on /login
- Click triggers redirect to Google consent
- State parameter carried correctly

children.title: OAuth callback handler + session establishment
children.body:
Implement /auth/google/callback to exchange the code for tokens, fetch the user profile, and establish a session.

**Acceptance:**
- Valid code → session cookie set, redirect to /home
- Invalid code → /login with error

children.title: Failed-consent error UX
children.body:
When Google consent is denied, return the user to /login with a clear error message.

**Acceptance:**
- Decline path shows 'You did not authorize sign-in.'
- No partial session is created
